notes:
High-level: Lighthouse Code Guard builds an automated PR-review assistant for enterprise GitHub orgs — focus on runnable suggestions, CI gating, and audit trails. Key ask: low-latency streaming into IDE panes (VSCode extension) and deterministic comment generation that dev teams can pin to model versions.

POC scope: onboard 2 private repos (service + infra). Run 2-week evaluation comparing: (A) Redwood hosted API w/ streaming + prefix caching, (B) Dedicated pool with quantized 7B models.

Requirements / quotes from call: 
- "We need comments that match our style guide ~85% of the time; false positives are painful."
- Must support model version pinning per repo and a safe rollback path.
- Want reranking pipeline for suggested comments: batch top-10 candidates, rerank w/ internal policy model.
- Latency: interactive IDE streaming <150ms 95th for single-file diffs; CI batch can be relaxed. Throughput target: sustain 1-2k QPS for autoscaler tests.
- Security: SSO (SAML), audit logs of suggestions & user feedback, optional data residency for EU customers. KMS for key management.

Acceptance criteria for POC: 
- End-to-end suggestion flow integrated into VSCode extension. Streaming tokens arrive incrementally.
- Mean time-to-first-token <80ms on dedicated config.
- Comment quality: precision @1 >= 0.7 on internal eval set.
- Reranker reduces unsafe suggestions by >=60% vs baseline.

Sticking points / blockers: 
- Legal wants explicit retention window (default 30 days anonymized) and ability to opt-out for certain repos.
- Ops asks for deterministic model pins + audit trail for rollouts. Need Redwood to show rollout/A-B capabilities.
- Cost sensitivity: engineering org is cost-aware; wants Optimize recommendations to minimize token spend without degrading comment quality.

Links: pricing deck (drive link), security FAQ (drive), legal NDA pending. POC timeline: provision infra by 2026-03-10, run 2-week evaluation, decision targeted 2026-04.

AE notes: push Redwood Optimize for batching/k-v cache settings, recommend dedicated for latency-sensitive IDE flows but show hosted path for fast time-to-value. Keep contact loop w/ Priya for kernel/quantization notes.
